decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Annotated Site Plan and D&A Statement [received 12 February 2019], Block Plan [received 17 December 2018], Location Plan [received 14 December 2018], 18.187_01_A, 18.187_02_A, 18.187_03_A, 18.187_04_A, 18.187_05_A and 18.187_06_A [received 11 December 2018], Structural Engineering Report [received 14 November 2018], and 18.187_01_A, Heritage Report and Tree Assessment [received 12 November 2018]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The replacement wall hereby permitted shall be constructed using as many of the original bricks as possible, with new or recovered bricks of the same colour and dimensions inserted only where these are unavailable.

Condition : 4 - The replacement wall hereby permitted shall be constructed using the mortar mix submitted in samples to the Council and shall be erected using the 'flush and brush' pointing style proposed by the applicant.

Condition : 5 - This approval is limited to the works shown on the approved drawings and does not indicate approval for associated or enabling works that may be necessary to carry out the scheme. Any further works must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any works commencing.
description: Rebuild collapsed Boundary wall as shown on Sections 1 and 2 of the structural engineers report. Rebuild like for like using as many of the original bricks as possible
